title: FTC and States Sue Amazon Over Alleged Hidden Ad Surcharge
dek: The FTC and 22 state attorneys general allege Amazon systematically charged advertisers more than its auction rules indicated, raising a new compliance and cost question for marketplace sellers and brands.
socialCaption: The FTC and 22 states allege Amazon used an undisclosed surcharge to raise ad prices beyond what its auction rules suggested. The case puts retail-media transparency—and advertiser cost controls—under a sharper spotlight.
